gaps.detail: TUR-S1SKIP names a winning last breakout; the source does not say how an open one counts. #709 VU-TUR lists "Hypothetischer noch offener Breakout als Gewinner angenommen" as a VU formalization. Both readings are implemented and reported (model assumption MA-TUR-S1-OPEN-BREAKOUT); neither is the source rule.

short side needs historical borrow / locate availability and fees, which are not in the snapshot (#709 data requirement short_interest MISSING). The equity adaptation is long only; short breakouts still feed the System 1 filter.

The source states only the failsafe ENTRY (TUR-FAILSAFE, HARD / HIGH, implemented as TUR-SF-FAILSAFE). Its exit is not published: #709 VU-TUR "Failsafe-Exit10 ist Auslegung, nicht ausdrücklich veröffentlichte Failsafe-Regel"; #709 revalidation TUR-F-FAILSAFE-55 "Ausstiegsregel für Failsafe-Positionen nicht ausdrücklich genannt"; #712 spec V4 T4-FAILSAFE "exit like S1 (interpretation)". Both readings are implemented and reported (model assumption MA-TUR-FAILSAFE-EXIT): 10-day (reference reading, path FAILSAFE_55 in every trade record) and 20-day (scenario FAILSAFE_EXIT_20D). Neither is SOURCE_EXACT; no reading is chosen by result.

the engine enforces both limits whenever a point-in-time group provider is supplied (sf-turtle-1.1.0). The binding is DATA_BLOCKED: the groups are futures market groups; for equities they need point-in-time industry membership or a declared correlation measure. The snapshot has neither (SEC SIC in the repository is CURRENT_ONLY, sic-peer-taxonomy-v1 backtestEligible false), and choosing a correlation threshold would add an unsourced parameter. Research runs therefore report correlationLimits NOT_EVALUATED_NO_PIT_GROUPS. Supertrader 3.0: point-in-time price data allow causal correlation groups, and pre-registered EQUITY MODEL variants are implemented as research (research/turtle-correlation.mjs: RAW / market-residual returns, 63 / 126 / 252 sessions, complete / average / single linkage, absolute and pair-quantile thresholds, explicit unknown policies); the binding stays blocked because the source names no measure, window or threshold (source-open) and no variant is owner-approved. Owner decision 2026-10-21: none of the variants is activated as a trading rule; they stay documented equity research models, no runner change, no change of the Turtle acceptance. Reference runs stay without groups.
